findings.result: Plane Shift is an accepted authored operational procedure, with exact acceptance133 and current index entry172. This is not an absent-source finding.

WP13 acquired Plane Shift at class level13, /WP13/spellbook/41; it is prepared at /WP13/prepared/0 with a completed preparation history. Wizard Conjuration rank7, Action, V/S/F, base17RP, mandatory caster travel.

A known impossible ward is rejected before payment by /spells/4/procedure and PT133-TRANSACTION. Simply placing WP13 knowingly inside a complete Sphere and deducting17RP would fail this source. A paid witness must establish a genuinely source-permitted hidden or later blocker, or use an accepted route with a committed per-attempt cost. Neither hidden knowledge nor a later ward is assumed here.

Current catalog /spells/143/operational/resolution explicitly spends the Steed Action and one crossing attempt at attempt start and retains both on ward-caused failure. This is an operative alternative to inspect, not proof of an acquired/instantiated owner, lawful command, endpoint or full body/cargo witness.

The preserved B4 parent already uses separately paid Levitate to support the enclosed creature; it does not create a floor in Sphere. Its /events/14 still records the missing destination/acquired attempt. No generic source-blocked flag closes it.
